verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it generates AI summaries of scanned mail and applies automatic AI labels and categorization inside the virtual mailbox. That is product-native AI insight derived from the user's mail. However, the evidence is only brief marketing copy, and nothing shows AI suggestions or recommended actions. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommended actions, in-depth documentation of what the summaries and insights cover, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Get instant AI summaries and automatic labels that help you stay on top of your mail, save time, and keep your inbox organized.
AI summaries and categorization that help you save time and stay organized
